notes: durable tool preference worded as a change
excerpt:
User: by the way, I switched from VS Code to Neovim last month and I'm not going back.
Assistant: Bold move! How's the config rabbit hole treating you?

User: my main project right now is Celestia, a local AI companion app I'm building on my own.
Assistant: Nice — how far along is it?

User: I live in Ankara but I'm visiting Berlin next week for a conference.
Assistant: Pack a jacket — Berlin's still cold this time of year.

User: I really like Hollow Knight and Celeste — they're my comfort games when work gets stressful.
Assistant: Both brutal and cozy at once. Great taste.

notes: pet name — relation may be phrased either direction
excerpt:
User: my cat Miso knocked my headphones off the desk again this morning.
Assistant: Classic cat tax. Is Miso remorseful at all?

notes: employment fact with role and employer
excerpt:
User: I started a new job as a data engineer at Vestel back in March, so weekdays are pretty full now.
Assistant: Congrats! How's the onboarding been?

notes: project tech stack, subject is the project not the user
excerpt:
User: Celestia runs entirely on Ollama — qwen2.5 7b handles chat and a 3b model does the background passes.
Assistant: Sensible split. The 3b keeps the hot path cheap.

notes: value change — must extract the NEW value, never the stale one; predicate left free (object is specific enough)
excerpt:
User: quick update — I moved the API server from port 8000 to 8765, the old one clashed with another service.
Assistant: Noted. 8765 it is.

notes: third-party facts about a named relative
excerpt:
User: my sister Deniz is a doctor, she lives in Izmir with her two kids.
Assistant: Sounds like a full house!

notes: PC spec stated as constraint context
excerpt:
User: my PC has an RTX 4070 with 12 GB of VRAM, that's why the 14b model doesn't fit alongside the TTS.
Assistant: Right — you'd need to unload one to run the other.

notes: habitual facts in a dense sentence — require the clearest one
excerpt:
User: on weekdays I wake up at 7, hit the gym before work on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and I stream on Twitch on Friday nights.
Assistant: That's a tight schedule — when do you fit Celestia work in?

notes: junk venting followed by one durable fact
excerpt:
User: ugh, the build failed again, third time today... anyway, unrelated: I adopted a dog last weekend, his name is Boncuk.
Assistant: Congrats on Boncuk! What breed?

notes: Turkish input — same facts, different language
excerpt:
User: bu arada ben Ankara'da yaşıyorum ve ana projem Celestia.
Assistant: Not aldım — ikisini de hatırlayacağım.

notes: greeting/small-talk — zero relations is the correct output
excerpt:
User: hey! how's it going today?
Assistant: Doing well! Ready to help whenever you are.

notes: meta-talk about the assistant's output — nothing durable
excerpt:
User: can you re-read that file and summarize it again? the last summary was way too long.
Assistant: Sure — here's a tighter version.

notes: assistant speculation, user non-committal — no USER-stated fact
excerpt:
Assistant: I think Rust would suit you — you seem to like strict compilers.
User: hmm, maybe. not sure I have time to learn it.

notes: one-off reminder — a task, not a relationship
excerpt:
User: remind me to take the trash out tonight before 9.
Assistant: Will do — I'll nudge you before 9.

notes: credentials must never become graph content
excerpt:
User: here's my API key sk-abc123xyz789, use it for the deploy script.
Assistant: I'd rather not store that — putting it in .env instead.
